verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs confirm an official SDK exists: backups can be created 'using the Pinecone SDK', and llms.txt describes official documentation covering SDKs. Nothing in the pack names which languages those SDKs cover, so the multi-language part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit evidence of official Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs, SDK reference documentation per language, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)
